info.lc2.comm_base_station: The Communication Base Station links adjacent Smart Ports and Cargo Stations to the remote control network. Accepts both EU and FE (1 EU = 4 FE; 4,000 EU / 16,000 FE capacity, LV 32 EU/t) with a 2 EU/t (8 FE/t) standby drain. Right-click with an Operation Terminal to bind, sneak-right-click to unbind, or right-click without a terminal to inspect power and linked stations.
info.lc2.operation_terminal: The Operation Terminal remotely manages bound Communication Base Stations and their adjacent logistics stations anywhere in the same dimension (requires loaded chunks and powered base stations). Right-click a Comm Base Station to bind, sneak-right-click or use the list to unbind, and right-click air/other blocks or press the hotkey (default G) to open the selection screen. Rechargeable via IC2 EU or FE chargers (10,000 EU / 40,000 FE capacity, LV 32 EU/t). Viewing and configuring is free; only successful remote launches cost 100 EU (400 FE). Equippable in Curios charm or belt slots.
